```{=html}
<!-- Figure 2: square-root channel animated on the simplex. The static SVG is a skeleton (outline + corner labels + grey p0 + empty layers); the script builds the resting view and the cloud-collapse animation. JS off or reduced motion => static labelled simplex. Geometry: vertices read from polygon.tri in e1,e2,e3 order. -->
<style>
.trajectory-animated{max-width:520px;margin:1.25rem auto;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
.trajectory-animated svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
.trajectory-animated .anim-hint{margin:.4rem 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.trajectory-animated .tr-vh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0;}
</style>
<div class="trajectory-animated">
<p class="tr-vh">Animation of the square-root channel S on the probability simplex. A cloud of states, coloured by its red-green-blue mixture, is mapped by S onto a line segment (the 2D simplex collapses to 1D), then by a second S onto the single grey maximally mixed point (1D collapses to 0D). The three pure corners e1, e2, e3 trace highlighted paths; e1 and e2 merge onto the same intermediate point. Plays once when scrolled into view; tap to replay.</p>
<svg role="img" aria-label="The square-root channel collapsing the probability simplex to its grey centre in two steps. The three pure-state corners are coloured red, green, and blue; a cloud of states flows under the channel onto a line segment, then onto the single grey maximally mixed point." xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 620" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif">
  <polygon class="tri" points="140,510 540,430 310,130" fill="none" stroke="#2d6f8f" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <g class="resting"></g>
  <g class="trails"></g>
  <g class="cloud"></g>
  <g class="hl"></g>
  <circle cx="330.0" cy="356.6666666666667" r="9" fill="#f5f7f8"/>
  <circle cx="330.0" cy="356.6666666666667" r="6" fill="#8a8f94"/>
  <text x="132" y="538" text-anchor="end" font-size="22" font-style="italic" fill="#cc3b3b">e₁</text>
  <text x="132" y="556" text-anchor="end" font-size="14" fill="#829aa6">(1, 0, 0)</text>
  <text x="556" y="438" text-anchor="start" font-size="22" font-style="italic" fill="#2e9e5b">e₂</text>
  <text x="556" y="456" text-anchor="start" font-size="14" fill="#829aa6">(0, 1, 0)</text>
  <text x="310" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-style="italic" fill="#3b6fb0">e₃</text>
  <text x="310" y="120" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#829aa6">(0, 0, 1)</text>
  <text x="346.0" y="352.6666666666667" font-size="22" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">p₀</text>
</svg>
<p class="anim-hint">Plays once on scroll. Tap to replay.</p>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  var COL=[[204,59,59],[46,158,91],[59,111,176]]; // e1 red, e2 green, e3 blue
  var S=[[0.5,0.5,0],[1/6,1/6,2/3],[1/3,1/3,1/3]]; // S^2 = P
  var CENTER=[1/3,1/3,1/3];
  var NPTS=150;
  function el(t,a){var e=document.createElementNS(NS,t);for(var k in a)e.setAttribute(k,a[k]);return e;}
  function applyS(p){return [S[0][0]*p[0]+S[0][1]*p[1]+S[0][2]*p[2],
                             S[1][0]*p[0]+S[1][1]*p[1]+S[1][2]*p[2],
                             S[2][0]*p[0]+S[2][1]*p[1]+S[2][2]*p[2]];}
  function lerp(a,b,u){var r=[];for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)r.push(a[i]+(b[i]-a[i])*u);return r;}
  function ease(t){return t<0.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;}

  function setup(root){
    var svg=root.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return;
    var tri=svg.querySelector('polygon.tri');
    if(!tri){var ps=svg.querySelectorAll('polygon');for(var i=0;i<ps.length;i++){if(ps[i].getAttribute('fill')==='none'){tri=ps[i];break;}}}
    if(!tri) return;
    var V=tri.getAttribute('points').trim().split(/\s+/).map(function(s){var c=s.split(',');return [parseFloat(c[0]),parseFloat(c[1])];});
    function b2c(p){return [p[0]*V[0][0]+p[1]*V[1][0]+p[2]*V[2][0], p[0]*V[0][1]+p[1]*V[1][1]+p[2]*V[2][1]];}
    function colof(p){var c=[];for(var k=0;k<3;k++){var v=Math.round(p[0]*COL[0][k]+p[1]*COL[1][k]+p[2]*COL[2][k]);c.push(Math.max(0,Math.min(255,v)));}return 'rgb('+c[0]+','+c[1]+','+c[2]+')';}
    function g(name){return svg.querySelector('g.'+name);}
    var gRest=g('resting'),gTrail=g('trails'),gCloud=g('cloud'),gHL=g('hl');
    var corners=[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]];
    var cornerCol=['rgb(204,59,59)','rgb(46,158,91)','rgb(59,111,176)'];
    function clear(node){while(node.firstChild)node.removeChild(node.firstChild);}
    function label(x,y,anchor,parts){var t=el('text',{x:x,y:y,'text-anchor':anchor,'font-size':16,fill:'#5e7886'});
      parts.forEach(function(pr){if(pr.i){var ts=el('tspan',{'font-style':'italic'});ts.appendChild(document.createTextNode(pr.t));t.appendChild(ts);}else t.appendChild(document.createTextNode(pr.t));});return t;}

    function buildResting(){
      clear(gRest);
      for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
        var pa=b2c(corners[i]),pb=b2c(applyS(corners[i])),pc=b2c(CENTER);
        gRest.appendChild(el('polyline',{points:pa[0]+','+pa[1]+' '+pb[0]+','+pb[1]+' '+pc[0]+','+pc[1],
          fill:'none',stroke:cornerCol[i],'stroke-width':2.2,'stroke-opacity':0.5,'stroke-linecap':'round','stroke-linejoin':'round'}));
      }
      var qa=b2c(applyS(corners[0])),qb=b2c(applyS(corners[2]));
      gRest.appendChild(el('circle',{cx:qa[0],cy:qa[1],r:5,fill:'#7d8f99',stroke:'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.2}));
      gRest.appendChild(el('circle',{cx:qb[0],cy:qb[1],r:5,fill:'#7d8f99',stroke:'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.2}));
      gRest.appendChild(label(qa[0],qa[1]-12,'middle',[{i:1,t:'Se'},{t:'₁ = '},{i:1,t:'Se'},{t:'₂'}]));
      gRest.appendChild(label(qb[0]+12,qb[1]+5,'start',[{i:1,t:'Se'},{t:'₃'}]));
      for(var j=0;j<3;j++){var p=b2c(corners[j]);gRest.appendChild(el('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1],r:6,fill:cornerCol[j]}));}
    }

    var cloud=[],hl=[];
    function buildAnim(){
      clear(gCloud);clear(gHL);clear(gTrail);cloud=[];hl=[];
      for(var i=0;i<NPTS;i++){
        var r1=Math.random(),r2=Math.random();
        var a=[1-Math.sqrt(r1),Math.sqrt(r1)*(1-r2),Math.sqrt(r1)*r2];
        var dot=el('circle',{r:3.1,'fill-opacity':0.85});gCloud.appendChild(dot);
        cloud.push({a:a,b:applyS(a),dot:dot});
      }
      for(var k=0;k<3;k++){
        var tr=el('polyline',{fill:'none',stroke:cornerCol[k],'stroke-width':2.6,'stroke-opacity':0.6,'stroke-linecap':'round','stroke-linejoin':'round'});gTrail.appendChild(tr);
        var d=el('circle',{r:6,fill:cornerCol[k],stroke:'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.3});gHL.appendChild(d);
        hl.push({a:corners[k],b:applyS(corners[k]),dot:d,trail:tr,path:[]});
      }
    }

    var A=1500,MID=700,B=1500,DUR=A+MID+B;
    function stateAt(o,t){
      if(t<A)return lerp(o.a,o.b,ease(t/A));
      if(t<A+MID)return o.b;
      if(t<A+MID+B)return lerp(o.b,CENTER,ease((t-A-MID)/B));
      return CENTER;
    }
    function showMode(anim){
      gRest.style.display=anim?'none':'';
      gCloud.style.display=anim?'':'none';
      gHL.style.display=anim?'':'none';
      gTrail.style.display=anim?'':'none';
    }
    var running=false;
    function animate(){
      if(running)return;running=true;buildAnim();showMode(true);
      var t0=null;
      function frame(now){
        if(t0===null)t0=now;var t=now-t0;if(t>DUR)t=DUR;var i,st,c;
        for(i=0;i<cloud.length;i++){st=stateAt(cloud[i],t);c=b2c(st);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('cx',c[0]);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('cy',c[1]);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('fill',colof(st));}
        for(i=0;i<hl.length;i++){st=stateAt(hl[i],t);c=b2c(st);hl[i].path.push(c[0]+','+c[1]);hl[i].trail.setAttribute('points',hl[i].path.join(' '));hl[i].dot.setAttribute('cx',c[0]);hl[i].dot.setAttribute('cy',c[1]);hl[i].dot.setAttribute('fill',colof(st));}
        if(t<DUR)requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        else setTimeout(function(){running=false;showMode(false);},900);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    buildResting();showMode(false);
    var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if(!reduce){
      svg.style.cursor='pointer';
      svg.addEventListener('click',animate);
      if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        var seen=false;
        var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++){if(es[i].isIntersecting&&!seen){seen=true;animate();}}},{threshold:0.25});
        io.observe(svg);
      }else animate();
    }
  }
  function init(){var rs=document.querySelectorAll('.trajectory-animated');for(var i=0;i<rs.length;i++)setup(rs[i]);}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
```
